slides.headline: Stars Don’t Tell The Whole Story
slides.description: Open with a striking split-screen: a familiar Google star rating on one side, and a dense multilingual review stream on the other. Layer in Bangkok fine dining imagery and subtle signals for food, service, ambience, waiting, and value to show how much insight is hidden beneath one number.
slides.narration: Bangkok’s fine dining reviews contain thousands of valuable signals—but they’re scattered across languages, ratings, and free text. A star average can’t tell operators what guests truly experience.

slides.headline: Turn Reviews Into Clear Signals
slides.description: Visualize the AI pipeline as a clean flow: Google Reviews enter, multilingual text is cleaned, then each review branches into business-relevant aspects with positive, neutral, or negative labels. Use animated tags such as food, service, ambience, waiting time, and value.
slides.narration: We collect roughly 15,000 to 30,000 reviews from 30 to 50 Bangkok restaurants, then use AI to classify sentiment across the moments that matter most to the business.

slides.headline: Benchmark What Guests Actually Feel
slides.description: Show a polished analytics dashboard with an AI Restaurant Score ranking, category comparison bars, competitive radar charts, and a positioning map comparing operational excellence with guest experience. Keep the visuals premium, legible, and decision-oriented.
slides.narration: The result goes beyond star ratings: an AI Restaurant Score, category benchmarks, competitive radar charts, and a market map that shows exactly where each restaurant stands.

slides.headline: Find The Moments That Matter
slides.description: Bring the customer journey to life from reservation and arrival through waiting, ordering, food, dessert, and payment. Highlight sentiment clusters at each stage, alongside a word cloud and trend line showing recurring themes and changes over time.
slides.narration: Operators can see where sentiment rises or breaks across the full guest journey, discover recurring language, and track whether service improves or a renovation changes perception.

slides.headline: Know What To Fix First
slides.description: End on a one-page restaurant benchmark report. Feature a clear biggest strength, biggest weakness, quick wins, competitor context, and prioritized recommendations. Close with a confident visual of an operator moving from insight to action.
slides.narration: Every restaurant receives a practical benchmark report: its strengths, weaknesses, market position, and priority actions—turning scattered feedback into focused investment decisions.
